red_prefilter.pro


Routines

top source red_prefilter

SST pipeline

result = red_prefilter(par, lambda, cwl)

Return value

Prefilter model profile as function of wavelength.

Parameters

par in type=fltarr

Profile model parameters. par[0] = par[1] = par[2] = par[3] = par[4] = par[5] = par[6] =

lambda in type=fltarr

Wavelengths in Ångström, for which the profile is to be returned.

cwl in type=float

Prefilter central wavelength in Ångström.
